full_judgment: 2. The petitioners as plaintiffs filed the suit for declaration of their title in respect of the suit land. The opposite Party No. 1 as defendant No. 30 is contesting the suit by filing written statement. The defendants Nos. 1-7 filed a joint written statement and the defendant Nos. 14-21, 23. 24, 26-28 also jointly filed written statement but they did not appear in the suit when the suit was taken up for hearing. During examination of the witnesses the plaintiffs prayed for amendment of the plaint for adding a prayer for recovery of khas possession and the said prayer was allowed against which the contesting defendant preferred Civil Revision No. 29 of 1982 under Section 115(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure before the court of Dist. Judge Dinajpur which on contest was rejected on 30.6.82 but allowed the defendant to cross examine the plaintiffs'' witnesses in the light of the amendment. Thereafter on 24.12.85 the court examined 3 witnesses of the plaintiff after rejecting an application for adjournment filed on behalf of the defendant on the ground of his sickness enclosing a medical certificate. Then on 11.1.86 the defendant filed an application to allow him to re-examine the aforesaid three witnesses examined on 24.12.85 stating that because of his illness he was absent on 24.12.85 and therefore, the learned Advocate did not get proper instruction to cross examine the aforesaid three witnesses on that date. This application was heard and disposed of on 16.4.86 by the impugned order allowing the prayer.
